recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future broad Pharmacy-versus-Workflow review should be tracked in new, specific Jira issues rather than reopening this already-published umbrella issue.
issue_request: FHIR-24100 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Pharmacy change request to compare the Pharmacy medication resources against Workflow and determine what changes should be made. The approved resolution said John Hatem would create new tickets as needed, and the later Jira application comment records the concrete applied change: removed Instantiates attributes in both MedicationRequest and MedicationAdministration.
initial_application: The direct source application appears in ece63351c6107ee2d837bd8bdc64871ad186dc4c, whose subject names FHIR-24100 and FHIR-32864. That commit removed MedicationAdministration.instantiatesCanonical, MedicationAdministration.instantiatesUri, MedicationRequest.instantiatesCanonical, MedicationRequest.instantiatesUri, and matching example instantiatesUri content. A second same-day commit, e1bf92f0d821b423705284646210373945cb0b4e, also names FHIR-24100/FHIR-32864 but only updated terminology source for shared value-set narrative work and did not reveal another workflow-alignment requirement. The removal commit is an ancestor of the current branch, the combined branch, and v5.0.0.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement and marks those resources approved. The R4-to-R5 map records MedicationAdministration.instantiates, MedicationRequest.instantiatesCanonical, and MedicationRequest.instantiatesUri as removed. Current medication source folders contain no instantiates elements, while the remaining workflow mappings still align medication administration/dispense/statement with Event and medication request with Request. Jira has no links or comments from other issues back to FHIR-24100. FHIR-32864 shared the historical commits but concerns medication reconciliation list guidance and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the concrete FHIR-24100 change has already been applied and published, and no later evidence shows a remaining current-build Pharmacy workflow correction for this Jira.
